description:
A fact table of 2 to 8 captured pricing pages, for research rather than building: per product,
plan names and prices, cheapest paid plan with currency, monthly/yearly toggle and saving, free
plan, trial, seat model, enterprise tier, notable limits, captured date and page url, plus a
Markdown table. Values are as captured; a field the capture doesn't state is null and listed
in missing (trial and seat model are quoted from the notes).

products.description: Comma-separated product ids, each compared by its captured pricing page, e.g. notion,slack,asana.

screens.description: Comma-separated pricing screen ids, e.g. notion-marketing-pricing (search_screens with pattern=pricing-page).

name: compare_pricing
title: Compare pricing pages as a fact table
